# The U Basketball Prep Academy

> Elite basketball prep academy in Glendale & Torrance, CA pairing professional basketball skills training with flexible online academics for middle and high school student-athletes. Backed by 30+ years developing NBA All-Stars, lottery picks, and top-tier youth prospects.

The U Basketball Prep Academy (also known as THE U PREP) is a full-service academic prep school and elite athletic academy — not a clinic or camp. Student-athletes train daily in "The Dojo" (the academy's training facility) under a professional development staff while completing accredited academics through a flexible online model. Admission is application-based; families begin with a questionnaire and a facility walkthrough.

## Key Facts

- Official name: The U Basketball Prep Academy (THE U PREP)
- Locations: The Dojo — 1219 Los Angeles St., Glendale, CA 91204 · Jump Beyond Sports — 1780 Oak St., Torrance, CA 90501
- Category: Private educational institution / basketball academy
- Audience: Middle school and high school student-athletes (homeschool or accredited online academic programs)
- Founder: Olin Simplis ("Coach O") — 30+ years developing NBA All-Stars, lottery picks, and top-tier youth prospects
- Training facility: The Dojo
- Contact: theuacademyonline@gmail.com · +1-310-617-3254
- Social: Instagram @theubasketballprepacademy · X @TheUBaballPrep · LinkedIn /company/the-u-basketball-prep-academy
- Enrollment: application-based for the 2026–2027 school year and upcoming semesters; 2:1 player-to-coach ratio
